synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 cells (obj x=row,y=col); ACTION5 cycles selection wall->pieces->wall; ACTION1-4 move selected piece one cell, or the mirror wall along its normal.
Each piece cell reflects across the mirror axis into solid gray reflection cells (clipped to board).
Layers wall<target<reflection<piece; cell centres are holes (selected object: black 0) through which targets show.
Extraction: walls/pieces/reflections are 4-connected components, targets per sprite, names sorted by (x,y); unselected wall index offset = count of black dots elsewhere.
Unconfirmed: movement blocking (bounds, piece overlap, crossing mirror), selection order with >1 piece, win/reset. Passes statelessly too.
